name: Yasuo
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. When you Stun or Recall an enemy, I deal 2 to it. Level up: You've Stunned or Recalled 5+ units.

name: Draven
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. When I'm summoned or strike: Create a Spinning Axe in hand. Level up: I've struck with 2+ total Spinning Axes.

name: Darius
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. Level up: I see the enemy Nexus has half of its starting Health or less.

name: Remembrance
text: I cost 1 less for each ally that died this round. Summon a random 5 cost follower from Demacia.

name: Purrsuit of Perfection
text: If you've played 20 new cards this game, summon Catastrophe.

name: Thermogenic Beam
text: To play, spend all your mana. Deal that much to a unit.

name: Eminent Benefactor
text: Play: Manifest an Epic card from your regions.

name: Braum
text: Keywords: Challenger, Regeneration. The first time I survive damage, summon a Mighty Poro. Level up: I've survived 10+ total damage.

name: Heart of the Fluft
text: Play: Combine your Poro followers into a Fluft of Poros, and grant it their stats and positive keywords.

name: The Undying
text: Keywords: Can't Block, Last Breath. Last Breath: Revive me at the next Round Start and grant me +1|+1 for each time I've died.

name: The Box
text: Deal 3 to each enemy that was summoned this round.

name: Possession
text: Steal an enemy follower this round. (Can't play if you have 6 allies or landmarks already.)

name: Ethereal Remitter
text: Play: Kill an ally to summon a random follower that costs 2 more.

name: Vi
text: Keywords: Challenger, Tough. While I'm in play or in hand, grant me +1|+0 when you play another card (max +8|+0). Level up: I've struck for 10+ damage in one strike.

name: Devourer of the Depths
text: Keywords: Deep. Play: Obliterate an enemy with less Health than me.

name: Riptide Rex
text: Keywords: Plunder. Plunder: Play Cannon Barrage 7 times on randomly targeted enemies.

name: Slotbot
text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Grant me +0|+1 for each card you drew last round, then shuffle my stats.

name: Plunder Poro
text: Keywords: Plunder. Plunder: Grant me 2 random keywords.

name: Pool Shark
text: When I'm summoned, draw 1 at the next Round Start and grant it Fleeting.

name: Gangplank
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When I'm summoned, summon a Powder Keg. Level up: You've damaged the enemy Nexus in 5+ different rounds.

name: Twisted Fate
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Play: Play a Destiny Card. Level up: I've seen you draw 9 cards.

name: Nautilus
text: Keywords: Tough, Fearsome. Level up: When you are Deep. When I level up, copy Tossed allies that cost 4+ into your deck.

name: Pick a Card
text: To play, place a card from hand into your deck. Draw 2 at the next Round Start and grant them Fleeting.

name: Playful Trickster
text: Remove an attacking ally from combat to Rally.

name: Ye Been Warned
text: Give an enemy Vulnerable this round. If it dies this round, draw 1.

name: Wolfrider
text: Keywords: Overwhelm, Plunder. Plunder: Get an empty mana gem.

name: Sejuani
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. Play: Give an enemy Frostbite and Vulnerable this round. Level up: You've damaged the enemy Nexus in 5+ different rounds.

name: Swain
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Nexus Strike: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus. Level up: You've dealt 14+ non-combat damage.

name: Sapling Toss
text: Summon a Sapling at the next Round Start.

name: Dragon's Rage
text: An ally kicks an enemy into the enemy Nexus, striking the enemy then the enemy Nexus. If the enemy survives, Recall it.

name: Riven
text: When I'm summoned, if you have the attack token, or when you gain the attack token, Reforge. Level up: You've created Blade of the Exile.

name: Survival Skills
text: Allies can't drop below 1 health this round. When discarded, your strongest ally can't drop below 1 health this round.

name: Tahm Kench
text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create an An Acquired Taste in hand. Level up: I've Captured 3+ units. When I level up, Obliterate my Captured enemies and release my allies.

name: Monkey Business
text: Keywords: Plunder. Summon a Powder Monkey. Plunder: Summon another at the next Round Start.

name: Vaults of Helia
text: Keywords: Landmark. Round Start: If you can, kill your most expensive ally to summon an ally from your deck that costs 1 more.

name: Morning Light
text: Give allies +1|+1 this round. Activate an ally's Daybreak effect.

name: Taric
text: Keywords: Support. Support: Give me and my supported ally Tough this round. Copy the last spell you played on only me this round onto that ally (It can't be copied again). Level up: I've seen you target or support allies 7+ times.

name: The Cloven Way
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. Nightfall: Stun an enemy. If it's a follower, Stun it again at the next Round Start.

name: Zoe
text: Keywords: Elusive. Nexus Strike: Create a Supercool Starchart in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost by 1. Level up: I've seen you play 10 cards with different names.

name: Eclipse Dragon
text: Keywords: Fury. Daybreak: The next Dragon or Celestial unit you play costs 2 less. Nightfall: Create a random Dragon and Celestial follower in hand.

name: Out Of The Way
text: For the rest of the game, allied "this round" buffs (except Barrier) are permanent. Draw 1.

name: Mountain Sojourners
text: Keywords: Support. Support: Grant my supported ally +2|+2. If it has Support, grant its supported ally +2|+2 and continue for each supported ally in succession.

name: Patched Porobot
text: While in hand, I have a random keyword that changes each round. When I'm summoned, grant me this keyword.

name: Mechanized Mimic
text: Keywords: Augment. Attack: Grant me all keywords on allies.

name: Give It All
text: Grow all allies' Power and Health to the highest Power or Health among allies. Grant all allies allied keywords.

name: Gluttony
text: Kill an ally with Last Breath to summon a follower from your deck that costs 1 more.

name: Passage Unearned
text: Obliterate all units that were summoned, but not played, this round.

name: Go Hard
text: Drain 1 from a unit. Create 2 copies of Go Hard in your deck. Every third time this happens, transform all copies of me everywhere into Pack Your Bags.

name: Singular Will
text: Pick an ally. Recall ALL other units and landmarks.

name: Go Get It
text: Recall an ally to summon an exact Ephemeral copy in its place. Reduce its cost to 0 this round.

name: Shyvana
text: Keywords: Fury. Attack: Give me +1|+1 this round. Level up: Dragon allies have dealt 16+ damage.

name: Revitalizing Roar
text: Pick a unit in hand to reveal. Heal your Nexus equal to its Power. Enlightened: Reduce its cost to 0.

name: Feel The Rush
text: Summon 2 different, random champions from your hand and deck. Grow their stats up to 10|10.

name: Production Surge
text: To play, spend all your mana. Summon random Turrets whose total cost equals the mana spent.

name: Defective Swapbot
text: Play: Swap my stats with another unit.

name: Volunteer Elnuk
text: When I'm summoned, create a random Elnuk in the top 6 cards of your deck.

name: Concurrent Timelines
text: Grant followers in your hand "When you play me, pick 1 of 3 followers with my cost and transform me into that follower."

name: Glorious Evolution
text: Your cards have -1 cost, Augment, are created by Glorious Evolution, and are now Tech.

name: Pyke
text: Keywords: Lurk, Quick Attack. When I Lurk, transform me into Death From Below. Level up: Allied Pykes have dealt 15+ damage.

name: Loaded Dice
text: Next round, when you damage the enemy Nexus, Nab 1.

name: Ripper's Bay
text: Keywords: Lurk, Landmark. When allies attack, before activating Lurk, grant the top ally in your deck Lurk and it becomes a Lurker.

name: Reaver's Row
text: Keywords: Countdown, Landmark. When I count down, summon a random 1 cost follower. Countdown 2: Grant 1 cost allies +2|+1 and Fearsome.

name: Ruined Rex
text: Play: Play Cannon Barrage on randomly targeted enemies for each card you've drawn this round, up to 6 times.

name: Renekton
text: Keywords: Overwhelm. When I Challenge an enemy, give me +2|+1 this round. Level up: I've dealt 10+ damage.

name: Sivir
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, SpellShield. Level up: You've dealt 30+ damage.

name: Nasus
text: Keywords: Fearsome. I have +1|+1 for each unit you've slain this game. Level up: I've struck for 10+ damage in one strike.

name: Chronoshift
text: Give an allied Champion "The next time I'd die this round, fully heal me and grant me +3|+3 instead".

name: Buried Sun Disc
text: Keywords: Countdown, Landmark. Start of Game: Summon 1 of me from your deck if it's all Shuriman. Countdown 25: Restore the Sun Disc. I advance 9 rounds for each time an Ascended ally has leveled up this game.

name: Grappling Hook
text: An ally you've targeted this round strikes an enemy.

name: Spirit Fire
text: Give enemies -2|-0 and "Round End: Deal 2 to me" this round.

name: Draklorn Inquisitor
text: When I'm summoned, summon a Frozen Thrall. Round End: If the Countdown of any of your Frozen Thralls is 4 or less, advance them to 0.

name: Cold Resistance
text: Get an empty mana gem and grant an ally +0|+2.

name: Fabled Poro
text: When I'm summoned, grant Poro allies a random keyword.

name: Black Rose Spy
text: Reputation: When I'm summoned, transform me into an exact copy of the strongest ally that struck this round.

name: LeBlanc
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Level up: I've seen you deal 15+ damage. When I level up, create a Mirror Image in hand.

name: Mask Mother
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Play: Kill an ally to grant me its stats and keywords.

name: Eye of the Ra-Horak
text: Keywords: Countdown, Landmark. Countdown 1: Stun the 2 weakest enemies. Daybreak: Summon a copy of me with Countdown 2.

name: Frightened Ibex
text: When I'm supported, give me and my supporting ally +1|+1 this round.

name: Starlit Epiphany
text: Invoke. If you have a Celestial ally, replace your deck with 20 copies of Behold the Infinite.

name: Honored Lord
text: The first time I Challenge an enemy, give me Barrier this round.

name: Field Promotion
text: The next time you play a unit this round, grant it Scout. It's now an Elite.
